subtitle: Cross-check of 14/Oct/2026, tenth day of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): Polymarket at the confirmed reading of 14/Oct, 18:12 BRT, the eleven national polls conducted after the vote, including [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 14/Oct and the four of 12 and 13/Oct (PoderData/Aya, BTG/Nexus, Futura/100% Cidades and Gerp), the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) final tally and the press flow of 13 and 14/Oct.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 14.50% (cumulative volume USD 23.09M) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 14/Oct, 18:12 BRT, holds steady against the confirmed reading of 14/Oct at 15:49 BRT, published in the previous update. COUNT: 45.16% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). POLL: 44% to 46% in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 14/Oct; ahead only in Vox Brasil of 09/Oct, 44.2% to 42.7%.
fortes: He leads Vox Brasil of 09/Oct by 44.2% to 42.7%, within the margin of 2.15 points, and has 50.86% of the valid votes.
In PoderData/Aya, the distance to Flávio Bolsonaro narrows from 5 points in the 05 to 07/Oct wave to 2 in the 10 to 12/Oct wave, within the margin of 1.8 points either way.
🏆 Counting the closed contracts, his contract is still the one with the highest cumulative volume in the presidential book, USD 23.09M.
fracos: He stands at 14.50% in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 14/Oct, 18:12 BRT, and Flávio Bolsonaro's gap over him is 70.50pp.

He trails in ten of the eleven national polls conducted after the vote: 44% to 46% in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 14/Oct, 46% to 48% in PoderData/Aya, 45% to 48% in BTG/Nexus and 46.6% to 50% in Futura/100% Cidades of 13/Oct and 44% to 53% in Gerp of 12/Oct.
He finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) 1.87 points behind Flávio Bolsonaro, with 45.16% of the valid votes against 47.03%.
In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 03/Oct government approval went from 46% to 44%, with 49% disapproval.
candidates.analise: Lula stands at 14.50% in the winner contract (cumulative volume USD 23.09M), confirmed reading of 14/Oct, 18:12 BRT, and holds steady against the confirmed reading of 14/Oct at 15:49 BRT, published in the previous update. 🗳️ He had 45.16% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). 📊 In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 14/Oct he has 44% against 46%, the same 2-point distance as in the 03/Oct wave; in PoderData/Aya of 13/Oct he had 46% against 48%. Between the night of 12/Oct and 13/Oct, PoderData/Aya gave Flávio Bolsonaro 48% to 46%, BTG/Nexus 48% to 45%, Futura/100% Cidades 50% to 46.6% and Gerp 53% to 44%; DataTrends of 11/Oct gave him 50% to 44%, and Vox Brasil of 09/Oct gave Lula 44.2% to 42.7%. On 13/Oct, Lula announced Prospera MEI, six measures for individual microentrepreneurs with debt forgiveness estimated at R$ 12.6 billion and a Pix of up to R$ 5 thousand, with part of it scheduled from 2027 (Poder360 and Estadão), and on 14/Oct he issued the regulations for the video games law with a promise of cheaper credit for the sector (Folha de S.Paulo and Valor). ⚖️ On 13/Oct, the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) president, Kassio Nunes Marques, again took down the "Exército do Lula" channel, overturning the decision of the inspector general (Corregedor-Geral) Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, and made its return conditional on registering the channel with the Electoral Justice; Lula's campaign registered the channel the same day, and Kassio authorized its return, which only takes effect 48 hours after the registration (Estadão, G1 and Metrópoles). Justice Marco Aurélio Bellizze gave Nikolas Ferreira and Flávio Bolsonaro 24 hours, with a deadline of the night of 14/Oct, to remove a video that uses children to criticize Lula (Gazeta do Povo, Estadão and Agência Brasil). Lula's campaign filed a complaint with the TSE against Meta after reports showed that WhatsApp's AI generated campaign material for Flávio Bolsonaro and blocked it for Lula (O Globo, Poder360 and VEJA). ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the polls or to the schedule: it measures the sides with each one's timestamp.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 85.00% (cumulative volume USD 20.12M) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 14/Oct, 18:12 BRT, down 0.05pp against the confirmed reading of 14/Oct at 15:49 BRT, published in the previous update. COUNT: 47.03% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). POLL: 46% to 44% in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 14/Oct; ahead in ten of the eleven post-vote national polls.
fortes: He finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) ahead, with 47.03% of the valid votes against Lula's 45.16%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally.
He stands at 85.00% in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 14/Oct, 18:12 BRT.

He leads ten of the eleven national polls conducted after the vote: 46% to 44% in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 14/Oct, 48% to 46% in PoderData/Aya, 48% to 45% in BTG/Nexus and 50% to 46.6% in Futura/100% Cidades of 13/Oct and 53% to 44% in Gerp of 12/Oct.
He has the declared support of Podemos, Augusto Cury, Novo, ACM Neto, PP, União Brasil, Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema and Michel Temer.
Among Ronaldo Caiado's voters, he has 56% against 15% in Ipespe, 54.9% against 26.9% in AtlasIntel and 57% against 19% in PoderData/Aya.
fracos: He trails in Vox Brasil of 09/Oct, with 42.7% against 44.2%, and in PoderData/Aya his lead narrows from 5 points to 2 between the 05 to 07/Oct and 10 to 12/Oct waves.

🏦 According to O Globo, the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) is investigating, in the inquiry into Daniel Vorcaro and Master's relationship with BRB, the bank's R$ 3.1 million financing to Flávio Bolsonaro for the purchase of a R$ 6 million mansion in Brasília; he says the transaction was legal, and the report comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution.

📰 Messages extracted from Daniel Vorcaro's phone and published by Estadão on 24/Sep show four attempts by him to contact the banker between 13 and 16 November 2025, in the days before Vorcaro's arrest, on 17 November 2025. Gazeta do Povo confirmed the authenticity of the exchanges with its own sources close to the investigation.
candidates.analise: Flávio Bolsonaro stands at 85.00% in the winner contract (cumulative volume USD 20.12M), confirmed reading of 14/Oct, 18:12 BRT, and falls 0.05pp against the confirmed reading of 14/Oct at 15:49 BRT, published in the previous update. 🗳️ He had 47.03% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). 📊 [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) released on 14/Oct the pollster's first wave in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): with 2,154 in-person interviews from 10 to 13/Oct, commissioned by Grupo Globo, Flávio Bolsonaro has 46% and Lula 44%, with 9% blank and spoiled ballots and 1% undecided; in the 03/Oct wave it was 44% and 42% (Metrópoles and Exame). Between the night of 12/Oct and 13/Oct, PoderData/Aya gave Flávio Bolsonaro 48% to 46%, BTG/Nexus 48% to 45%, Futura/100% Cidades 50% to 46.6% and Gerp 53% to 44%; DataTrends of 11/Oct gave him 50% to 44%, and Vox Brasil of 09/Oct gave Lula 44.2% to 42.7%. 🤝 Flávio Bolsonaro has the declared support of Podemos, Augusto Cury, Novo, ACM Neto, PP, União Brasil, Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema, Michel Temer and the MDB, which on 13/Oct formalized the support of 17 state branches (Gazeta do Povo and Folha de S.Paulo); 10 MDB branches, from the North and Northeast, declared support for Lula (Estadão, Valor and CartaCapital). PSDB stayed neutral. Lula has the support of UP, PSTU and PCB (CNN Brasil and G1), and Renan Santos still backs no one (CNN Brasil and Estadão). On 13/Oct, Flávio Bolsonaro said he will vote in the Senate in favour of ending the 6x1 work schedule (six days on, one off) and that he would not attend the Band debate, scheduled for 18/Oct, but on 14/Oct said he will, after Lula confirmed his attendance (UOL, Gazeta do Povo, CartaCapital and CNN Brasil). The Senate debates the PEC to end the 6x1 schedule on 14/Oct, with a vote scheduled for the same day (VEJA and G1), and the Senate Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ) approved the Public Security PEC on the morning of 14/Oct (Gazeta do Povo and Metrópoles). ⚖️ On 13/Oct, the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) president, Kassio Nunes Marques, again took down the "Exército do Lula" channel, overturning the decision of the inspector general (Corregedor-Geral) Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, and made its return conditional on registering the channel with the Electoral Justice; Lula's campaign registered the channel the same day, and Kassio authorized its return, which only takes effect 48 hours after the registration (Estadão, G1 and Metrópoles). Justice Marco Aurélio Bellizze gave Nikolas Ferreira and Flávio Bolsonaro 24 hours, with a deadline of the night of 14/Oct, to remove a video that uses children to criticize Lula (Gazeta do Povo, Estadão and Agência Brasil). Lula's campaign filed a complaint with the TSE against Meta after reports showed that WhatsApp's AI generated campaign material for Flávio Bolsonaro and blocked it for Lula (O Globo, Poder360 and VEJA). ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the polls or to the endorsements: it measures the sides with each one's timestamp.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): third place, with 2.89% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. PRICE: winner contract closed and resolved at zero, with USD 5.51M cumulative. [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro on 08/Oct (G1, Estadão and CNN Brasil).
fortes: He finished third, with 2.89% of the valid votes, ahead of Renan Santos and Ronaldo Caiado.
The [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno)'s third-place book was resolved in his favour.
fracos: He is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and his contract in the winner book was resolved at zero.
On the eve the third-place book paid more for Renan Santos, 47.50%, and for Ronaldo Caiado, 30.00%, than for him, 23.70%.
candidates.analise: Augusto Cury finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in third, with 2.89% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally, and is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). His contract in the winner book was closed by Polymarket after the first round and resolved at zero, with USD 5.51M cumulative. The first round's third-place book, which on the eve paid 23.70% for him, at 23:00 UTC on 03/Oct, was resolved in his favour. 🤝 On 08/Oct he declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round (G1, Estadão and CNN Brasil).

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): fourth place, with 2.24% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. PRICE: winner contract closed and resolved at zero, with USD 17.12M cumulative. [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): he backs neither of the two.
fortes: He finished fourth, with 2.24% of the valid votes, ahead of Ronaldo Caiado, with 2.18%.
His contract in the winner book closed with USD 17.12M cumulative, the second largest in the presidential book.
fracos: He is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and his contract in the winner book was resolved at zero.
On the eve the third-place book paid 47.50% for him, and third place went to Augusto Cury.
candidates.analise: Renan Santos finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in fourth, with 2.24% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally, and is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). His contract in the winner book was closed by Polymarket after the first round and resolved at zero, with USD 17.12M cumulative, the second largest in the presidential book, behind Lula's. On the eve the third-place book paid 47.50% for him, at 23:00 UTC on 03/Oct, and it was resolved in favour of Augusto Cury. 🤝 On the night of 04/Oct he said he backs neither of the two in the second round and freed Missão's activists to choose (Gazeta do Povo and Agência Brasil).

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): Ronaldo Caiado, with 2.18% of the valid votes, and Romeu Zema, with 0.27%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. Fernando Haddad did not run for President. PRICE: the three winner contracts were closed and resolved at zero.
candidates.subtitle: The three names outside the leading pack, with the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) final tally (100% of polling sections) and the closing of the winner contracts after the first round.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), eliminated in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) with 2.18% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.82M cumulative.
caiado.fortes: He declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro in Goiânia on 06/Oct, with governor Daniel Vilela (O Globo and VEJA).
caiado.fracos: He finished fifth, behind Renan Santos, and the PSD decided on neutrality in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (Folha de S.Paulo and Agência Brasil).

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), did not run for President: he ran for governor of São Paulo and lost to Tarcísio de Freitas in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.74M cumulative.
haddad.fortes: The top of his series in the winner contract was 7.60%, on 26/May, measured in the database backup.
haddad.fracos: He was not measured by any national poll in a presidential scenario or in a second-round pairing.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), eliminated in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) with 0.27% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.74M cumulative.
zema.fortes: ⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep, 81% of his voters would go to Flávio Bolsonaro in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), the largest transfer among the names measured (O Globo).
zema.fracos: He had 0.27% of the valid votes. He declared his vote for Flávio Bolsonaro on 05/Oct, and Novo declared support for him on 07/Oct (G1 and CartaCapital).

candidates.analise: 🗳️ Ronaldo Caiado finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in fifth, with 2.18% of the valid votes, and Romeu Zema had 0.27%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. Fernando Haddad ran for governor of São Paulo, not for President. The three contracts in the winner book were closed by Polymarket and resolved at zero. 🤝 Romeu Zema declared his vote for Flávio Bolsonaro on the night of 05/Oct (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo), and Novo, his party, declared support on 07/Oct (G1 and CartaCapital). Ronaldo Caiado declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro in Goiânia on 06/Oct (O Globo and VEJA), even with the PSD neutral in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (Folha de S.Paulo and Agência Brasil).
fortes: Ronaldo Caiado declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro on 06/Oct (O Globo and VEJA), and Romeu Zema declared his vote for him on 05/Oct, followed by Novo on 07/Oct (G1 and CartaCapital).
⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep, 81% of Romeu Zema's voters and 42% of Ronaldo Caiado's would go to Flávio Bolsonaro in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (O Globo).
fracos: The two are out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and the winner contracts of all three names were resolved at zero.
Fernando Haddad did not run for President: he ran for governor of São Paulo and lost to Tarcísio de Freitas in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno).

cruzamento: Tenth day of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), with [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) and eleven national polls conducted after the vote. 💹 In the confirmed reading of 14/Oct, 18:12 BRT, Flávio Bolsonaro falls 0.05pp and Lula holds steady against the confirmed reading of 14/Oct at 15:49 BRT, published in the previous update, and the gap goes from 70.55pp to 70.50pp. 📊 Quaest released on 14/Oct the pollster's first wave in the second round: with 2,154 in-person interviews from 10 to 13/Oct, commissioned by Grupo Globo, Flávio Bolsonaro has 46% and Lula 44%, with 9% blank and spoiled ballots and 1% undecided; in the 03/Oct wave it was 44% and 42% (Metrópoles and Exame). Between the night of 12/Oct and 13/Oct, PoderData/Aya gave Flávio Bolsonaro 48% to 46%, BTG/Nexus 48% to 45%, Futura/100% Cidades 50% to 46.6% and Gerp 53% to 44%; DataTrends of 11/Oct gave him 50% to 44%, and Vox Brasil of 09/Oct gave Lula 44.2% to 42.7%. Of the eleven national polls conducted after the vote, ten put Flávio Bolsonaro ahead, by 2 to 9 points in total votes, and Vox Brasil puts Lula ahead by 1.5 points. On rejection, 46% would not vote for Lula under any circumstances and 44% for Flávio Bolsonaro in PoderData/Aya, and 51% and 47% in BTG/Nexus. The voters of Augusto Cury, who declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro on 08/Oct, go to him by 56% to 27% in PoderData/Aya and by 50% to 29% in Ipespe, and to Lula by 50.4% to 38.9% in AtlasIntel. Among Ronaldo Caiado's voters, all three point to Flávio Bolsonaro. 🤝 Flávio Bolsonaro has the declared support of Podemos, Augusto Cury, Novo, ACM Neto, PP, União Brasil, Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema, Michel Temer and the MDB, which on 13/Oct formalized the support of 17 state branches (Gazeta do Povo and Folha de S.Paulo); 10 MDB branches, from the North and Northeast, declared support for Lula (Estadão, Valor and CartaCapital). PSDB stayed neutral. Lula has the support of UP, PSTU and PCB (CNN Brasil and G1), and Renan Santos still backs no one (CNN Brasil and Estadão). ⚖️ On 13/Oct, the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) president, Kassio Nunes Marques, again took down the "Exército do Lula" channel, overturning the decision of the inspector general (Corregedor-Geral) Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, and made its return conditional on registering the channel with the Electoral Justice; Lula's campaign registered the channel the same day, and Kassio authorized its return, which only takes effect 48 hours after the registration (Estadão, G1 and Metrópoles). Justice Marco Aurélio Bellizze gave Nikolas Ferreira and Flávio Bolsonaro 24 hours, with a deadline of the night of 14/Oct, to remove a video that uses children to criticize Lula (Gazeta do Povo, Estadão and Agência Brasil). Lula's campaign filed a complaint with the TSE against Meta after reports showed that WhatsApp's AI generated campaign material for Flávio Bolsonaro and blocked it for Lula (O Globo, Poder360 and VEJA). 🎙️ Record cancelled the 11/Oct debate, and the debates scheduled for the second round are Band's, on 18/Oct, the first, and Globo's, on 23/Oct, plus interviews with both candidates on Globo on 15 and 16/Oct (Congresso em Foco, CNN Brasil and Valor). 📊 The next national polls registered with the TSE come out on 15/Oct (Datafolha, Palver and Indexa), 16/Oct (PoderData, MDA, 100 Cidades and Datavero), 17/Oct (Veritá and Ipespe), 18/Oct (Vox Brasil and Phoenix) and 19/Oct (AtlasIntel, PoderData, BTG/Nexus, DataTrends and 100 Cidades). ⛔ The panel does not attribute price moves to the polls, the endorsements or the day's acts: it measures the sides with each one's timestamps.
